description: Gets one doctor's public record by 10-digit NPI. The record lists offices, specialties, ratings for each scored procedure and the reasons for those ratings, affiliated hospitals, federal exclusion-list checks, state medical board actions matched by license number in states OpenHealth covers, and published procedure counts and outcome measures with their sources. Each rating predicts results at the doctor's affiliated hospitals. OpenHealth gives no overall doctor score.
name: get_doctor
title: Get a doctor's public record
